description: Inline collapsible page-comment panel with an unresolved-count badge. Lists comment threads with resolve and watch, nested entries with reactions and edit/delete, inline and thread replies, and a new-comment mention input.

parameters.name: OnDraftChanged
parameters.description: Fires whenever the TmNotionCommentDraftState value changes — any of the panel's composers (new comment, thread reply, inline reply, entry edit) gained/lost content. Value-equality deduped, so it does NOT fire on every keystroke. No composer text is observable through a parameter; use TmNotionCommentDraftState to build a dirty-guard before a navigation that would silently discard an in-progress comment. Opening an edit or an inline reply reports its id/state immediately while HasUnsavedContent stays false until real user content exists (an edit differing from the entry body, a reply beyond the auto-inserted quote). Pair with HasUnsavedDraft for polling and DiscardDraftAsync for the discard after the consumer's own confirmation.
